messages:
Priya (CS): quick async — Marigold renewal meeting tomorrow 9am PST. Main open items: webhook retries causing alerts, embedding quality dip from last week, and a small contract question. tagging eng for status. /cc @Omar @Tess
Omar (Eng): saw the 3x spike in webhook 502s last Tue. root cause looks like retry backoff + k8s pod churn. i'll push a small backoff tweak and bump retry count. planning a canary today. ETA ~1500 PT. will post patch link.
Tess (Eng-ML): embedding quality drop — looks like marigold got auto-routed to our quantized-small variant last week. i'm re-running evals on their prompt set, suspect tokenization mismatch. if confirmed i'll pin them back to float32 canary for the renewal call.
Liam (Solutions): fyi marigold's SRE said they rotated the signing key but didn’t update endpoint config — could explain 401/502 mix. CS is coordinating a creds rotation window tomorrow pre-meeting.
Priya (CS): thanks — can we have both fixes gated behind a rollback path? renewal team wants low risk. also need a short note we can send to the customer: who's owning the message?
Omar (Eng): i'll own the retry patch + rollback. opening PR now. if canary regresses we can revert via rollout flag.
Tess (Eng-ML): i'll prepare a 1-paragraph summary of the evals (before/after) and recommended pin. will attach numbers here.
Liam (Solutions): i'll draft the customer note and share for quick review. ping me when PR merged.
Priya (CS): blockers from CS: none besides final approval on the note. @Aisha any contractual concerns?
Aisha (CS Manager): just ensure support docs include the pinned-model option. confirm if Dedicated customers need a config change on their side.
Omar (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987 — backoff tweak + feature flag. canary started on staging at 16:05 PT. logs:```
[16:06:12] webhook-handler INFO retry=1 status=502 id=marigold-evt-123
[16:06:13] webhook-handler INFO retry=2 status=200 id=marigold-evt-123
```
Tess (Eng-ML): eval snapshot: normalized-bleu on their prompt set dropped 0.60 -> 0.57 after auto-route. when routed to v1.9f float32 it returns to 0.60. recommend pin to v1.9f for the call.
Liam (Solutions): draft note (short): "We saw transient webhook failures and an embedding variant change. Please rotate the signing key in your console (window: tomorrow 7–8am PST) and we'll temporarily pin model to restore quality. We'll follow up with a post-mortem." sharing doc link shortly.
Priya (CS): perfect. one ask: can we add an opt-in toggle in the console to pin model per-customer? product?
Evan (Product): we can add a temporary toggle, timeline is ~2 sprints. short-term: Solutions can apply a per-customer config change.
Aisha (CS Manager): final: post the customer note when ready and i'll follow up on the contract clause.
Omar (Eng): update — canary looks clean, rolling to 10% prod now. if anyone sees errors in next 30m @channel.
Tess (Eng-ML): pinned test done — quality restored with v1.9f. i'll attach the eval doc for the renewal call.
Priya (CS): thanks team. i'll send the note and prep the meeting slides. closing async. :thumbsup:
